recipe.visualDefinition: A vibrant red square composition featuring a dark blue silhouette of a child in prayer on the right, balanced by a dense list of serif text on the left, all framed by a thin yellow border.
coreVisualRelationships: Silhouette anchored to the bottom right corner
Text block justified left to balance the visual weight of the silhouette
Title arched across the top center
High contrast between deep blue elements and bright red background
coreInvariants: Thin yellow inner border framing the entire composition
Textured, painterly red background with orange highlights
Dark blue silhouette with soft, irregular edges

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large silhouette occupying the bottom right quadrant, scaled to approximately 60% of the height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark blue silhouette provides the primary visual weight.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the arched title, moves down the list of names on the left, and settles on the silhouette and bottom credits.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Active negative space created by the textured red background between the text and the silhouette.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Vibrant red with orange texture for the background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep navy blue for the silhouette and primary title.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright yellow for the thin border and small highlights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation red background contrasted with low value, high density blue elements.

letterConstructionRules: Title uses a casual, rounded sans-serif with a heavy offset drop shadow
Body text uses a condensed, high-contrast serif
Subtitles use a fluid, slanted script
characterSpecificRedesigns: Title characters are slightly rotated and staggered to create a bouncy, informal rhythm
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Casual display face paired with a formal, dense serif for information-heavy sections.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Comic Sans or similar casual face
candidateDirections.reason: Matches the informal, bouncy feel of the main title
Provides the necessary legibility for the dense list of names

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a textured red background with orange sponge-like patterns. Place a dark blue silhouette of a child in a praying profile on the right side. Add a thin yellow border inside the frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the arched title in a navy blue casual font with a dark shadow at the top. Place a dense list of names in a black serif font on the left side, ensuring it does not overlap the silhouette.

verificationChecks: Is there a thin yellow border?

mustAchieve: High contrast between blue and red
avoid: Overlapping text on the silhouette face

postGenerationChecks: Ensure silhouette is a solid dark color
Confirm text is left-aligned in the list area
recipe.reuseFormula: Silhouette + Textured Background + List Layout + Arched Title
